name: Tryvertising Reorder Reminders
author: zentraglow

sections.description:
Stores selling consumables — coffee, skincare, supplements, household supplies, pet food — lose repeat sales because customers forget to reorder. Tryvertising Reorder Reminders sends a reminder email when a product is likely running out, based on a day interval you set globally, per product, or per variation.

Free features: per-product on/off, global + per-product + variation day intervals, daily check, one reminder email with a reorder link, unsubscribe, sent/pending/failed log, and a test email.

This plugin is built to be small, focused, and clear about its limits, including email delivery, which depends on the mail setup on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Tryvertising Reorder Reminders and set the default interval.
  3. Edit a product and tick “Enable reorder reminders”, optionally with its own interval.
  4. Run the daily check from the settings page to create reminders from past orders.
sections.faq:
Will reminders be sent for products I have not enabled?

No. A product must be opted in. The default is off.

What if a customer reorders before the reminder is due?

The daily check only looks at the most recent purchase per customer and product, so an older order does not create a reminder after a newer purchase.

How do customers unsubscribe?

Every reminder email has an unsubscribe link. It stops reminders for that product only, and needs no login.

Will the email definitely arrive?

Delivery depends on the mail setup on your site. On a local test site with no mail transport, sending fails and the reminder is logged as failed, not sent. Test delivery on a real host before relying on it.
